notes.title: August 20, 2025 (Wed) Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries! 

The update on August 20 will introduce a decoration item box that contains battlesuit, emote, emoji, and title. Also, daily mission related price will be adjusted with the changes to daily missions. Also, credit charge will be removed and balance will be adjusted. 

[h3][Maintenance Schedule][/h3]
[b]1. Maintenance Date: August 20, 2025 (Wed)[/b]
[b]2. Maintenance Time: 02:00 - 05:00 (3 Hours) (UTC+0)[/b]

[h3][Update Info][/h3]
[b]■ Decoration Item Box Update [/b]
The update on August 20 will introduce a decoration item box that contains battlesuit, emote, emoji, and title. The box will include various pre-existing decoration items and also new items. The box can be purchased with 750 Gold in the shop. 
Upon opening the decoration box, acquire 1 random item out of the following list.

notes.title: [Updated on 2025-08-06]August 6, 2025 (Wed) Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries! 

The update on August 6, 2025 will bring improvements to Rust, revamp to Elvacia weapons, and new Conquest map: Isolated Supply Lines. On top of that, new tournament mode update and skill/module UX improvements will be made. 

[h3][Maintenance Schedule][/h3]
[b]1. Maintenance Date: August 6, 2025 (Wed)[/b]
[b]2. Maintenance Time: 02:00 - 06:00 (4 Hours) (UTC+0)[/b]

[h3][Update Info][/h3]
[b]■ Rust Character Improvement [/b]
Rust will be improved so that the complexity of the character will be eased while there are some controls involved to fit the nature of shooter games. 
Please check out the details below. 
1. The following weapons will be adjusted.

[tr]
    [th]Weapon[/th]
    [th]Changes  [/th]
[/tr]

[/tr]
[tr]

    [td]Added as Normal Weapon. [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Recharging Drone[/td]
    [td]Changed to Special Weapon.  [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Beam Turret[/td]
    [td]Changed to Special Weapon. [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Shield Bash Turret[/td]

Shield Bash Turret Weapon Ticket will be changed to Hand Cannon Weapon Ticket.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
    [td]Recall Drone[/td]
    [td]The weapon will be removed.
Recall Drone Weapon Ticket will be changed to Song of Iron Weapon Ticket.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
 - Equipped Normal Weapon will be changed to Hand Cannon. If Shield Bash Turret or Recall Drone is equipped to Special Weapon, they will be changed to Beam Turret.
 - Hand Cannon and Song of Iron Use Achievement will be added and Shield Bash Turret and Recall Drone Use Achievement will be removed. Those that have progressed through these weapons will receive 400 gold per achievement completed by mail.
 - Changed so that the available weapon will be changed in the Weapon Ticket Select Box by Grade.

notes.title: August 6, 2025 Update Preview
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries!

The update on August 6 will bring improvements to Rust, a new character introduced in July. 
Also 3 weapons will be added/removed for Elvacia, a new Conquest match map will be introduced, and Skill/Module Page UX will be improved as well. 
Please check out the details below.

[b]1. Rust Character Improvement[/b]
Rust will be improved so that the complexity of the character will be eased while there are some controls involved to fit the nature of shooter games. To bring this change, we plan to provide 2 new basic weapons that can directly attack enemies and change Recharging Drone and Beam Turret to Special Weapon. Also, weapons with low usage such as Shield Bash and Recall Drone will be removed. 
With the improvements to Rust, we expect that the base skill will also see some low usage. Therefore, we plan to change Rust’s Mercenary Skills as well.

[b]2. 3 Elvacia Weapons Added/Removed[/b]
We will be improving Elvacia’s weapons so that enemies will not just have a single type of combat experience against her. To achieve this, Shotgun Pistol, Explosive Shotgun Pistol, and Triple Barrel will be removed and Fated Trajectory, Frostseed, and Light of Judgment will be added. With the removal of weapons, related achievements will be removed. Players who were progressing through the achievement will receive gold compensation.

[b]3. New Blackstar Capture Map: Isolated Supply Lines[/b]
A 3rd Blackstar Capture map in the theme of Scars of War: Isolated Supply Lines will be added. The map is smaller than the other maps, causing players to be pitted against each other, resulting in fiercer battles against each other. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/514ba1c0f357e571d2252aed768e6ede8e89afb6.gif[/img]

[b]4. Skill / Module Page UX Improvements[/b]
To provide a better understanding of each mercenaries and their skills, Skill Page UI and description will be improved. The Module Page will also be improved so that players can see the type of modules in possession and manage modules with more ease in general. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/e6182c08065676aba2557afd728a3f740718d7e7.png[/img]

notes.title: July 16, Developer’s Notes
notes.content:
Hello Mercenaries!

We’d like to share some update information that players have been waiting for. In this update, we have prepared various contents that allow more actions and tactical choices in battle.

[b]1. New Match Map[/b]
A new Conquest Map will be added. This map will be smaller than other maps to allow even more fiery close-range, quick combat. With its level design far separated from the existing maps, players will need new tactics and quick decision-making to fend off the enemies. Battle against enemies in new terrain.

[b]2. Mercenary ‘Elvacia’ Weapon Revamp[/b]
Some weapons will be revamped for Elvacia. Triple Barrel, Shotgun Pistol, and Explosive Shotgun Pistol will be swapped out for weapons specialized in ranged battle. With this revamp, Elvacia will have more tactical option for enemies at varying distances, allowing more tactical gameplay and new gameplay style.

[b]3. UI and System Quality of Life Improvement[/b]
Result screen will be improved. Now, players can see daily mission and commission progress and reward in one glance. Players will no longer need to look for menus to find what they’re looking for. Skill System will also be revamped. Players will be able to see and understand mercenary skills with the revamped UI and tooltip. Players of all skill levels will benefit from this update.

We will continue to bring quality of life changes and content updates to improve gameplay enjoyment. 

Thank you.

1. Matchmaking settings for the selected language will be moved to Settings Window and removed the Daily Calculation Count display below the Game Start button will be removed.

3. Fixed the description for Calculation Count in Lobby.
4. Improved so that Team Color will be displayed for the Robot Icon in the minimap of Payload Push.
5. Changed the Skill and Exclusive Effect in Lobby Mercenary Window and changed the icon design of Exclusive Effects.
6. Improved the Tournament Guide System so that players can see the tournament system progress.
7. Improved and Added some UI Sound.
8. Added more source of acquisition for Medal of Bravery.
9. Added 1 new way to display aim line.
10. Improved the close shooting and far shooting to be displayed as meter (m).
11. Changed the Equipment List to be sorted so that higher rank equipment will be displayed first in the lobby equipment window.
12. Improved the respawn time display for Elite/Boss Monsters in Rush Battleground.
13. Changed so that players hit in the bush will be revealed to all enemies for 1 second.
14. Improved so that License Registration will be seen in Weapon Select Box pop-up window. 
15. Added results that display mission goals and progress in the result window.

[h3][Bug Fixes][/h3]
1. Fixed a bug where Final Defense would not activate for Urth if it was double-clicked with another weapon equipped.
2. Fixed a bug where the player would respawn from the respawn point in the previous round if the player died right before the end of round in Conquest. 
3. Fixed a bug where using Final Defense on allies in the bush would cause the effect to not be on display even if the ally walked out of the bush. 
4. Fixed a bug where players would be matched against AI Players with duplicate names.
5. Fixed a bug where Consecutive Kill Notification would not reset and continue on to the next match even if players had already finished Conquest or Rush Battleground.
6. Fixed a bug where players would encounter messages that say Mercenaries not in possession cannot go through the commission even when the player possesses that mercenary.
7. Fixed a bug where notification for consecutive kills would only display for the mercenary first killed if multiple mercenaries have been defeated at once.
8. Fixed a bug where AI Players that have died at the end of round would start the round from the spots they have fallen in the next round in Conquest.
9. Fixed a bug where players would be knocked down after the unstoppable effect if they were applied with unstoppable effect before falling.
10. Fixed a bug where the Blackstar Fragment in possession did not display as intended in the result screen if the player died during the countdown in Blackstar Capture.
11. Fixed a bug where the translation for ‘Game Start’ would not be applied upon entering Tournament Round.
12. Fixed a bug where the drone would not attack if the enemy mercenary used ‘Sturdy Shield’ right when the drone would be created for ‘Obsessive Friend’.

notes.title: July 9, 2025 Update Preview
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries!

The update on July 9 will bring the end of Season 3 and the start of Season 4.
Also, a new mercenary who summons mechanical devices in combat: Rust will be added. New Mercenary Challenge System that gives purpose and reward in games will be updated as well.
Please check out the details below.

[b]1. Season 4 Update [/b]
The long 3 month journey will end and a new season will begin. The new season will have Rank and Rank Rewards reset. New Attendance Log Rewards and Battle Pass will begin. On top of that, Weapon Balance, Play Rewards, and many other improvements will be made. 
Title Rewards will be given out based on Season 3 Ranks. Strive for higher ranks to achieve the highest ranks in Season 3.

[b]2. New Mercenary: Rust [/b]
Rust can summon turrets, drones, and other machine devices to attack enemies or assist allies. This new mercenary will be released along with the update. The new mercenary is very mobile and can battle with enemies without the need for precise controls, enhancing the machine devices through skills and ultimate. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/f8c346e01decec17c37633a701f3520d84d7dc80.png[/img]

[b]3. New Mercenary Challenge[/b]
A system will be updated where it will guide players through contents and provide a purpose in game. The new system can be checked in the right-hand bottom corner of the lobby. A total of 15 guides will assist players through quests, providing a sense of achievement and purpose in the game. 

[b]4. New Portal: VK Play[/b]
Return Alive will launch through VK Play, the biggest publisher in Russia. The portal will allow players to play with the existing Steam and Epic Store players, allowing bigger player pool for players to play with.

notes.title: June 18, Developer’s Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries! 

We’re here to provide new information on New Season and Updates! In this patch, a new season will start and rewards will be improved. Also, a new mercenary will join our ranks and a balance adjustment patch will roll out as well. 

[b]1. Start of Season 4[/b]
A new season will begin. With the start of the new season, challenge yourself to various rewards that will be added as well. Various event rewards are in store along with the Battle Pass. A title reward will be sent out for all top ranked players of season 3.

[b]2. New Mercenary: Rust[/b]
A new mercenary Rust will be added to the game. Rust uses a completely new system separate from the existing mercenaries. Rust is a mercenary that can engage in combat without complicated maneuver. Rust can summon turrets, drones, and other machine devices to attack enemies or assist allies. Rust can empower the machine devices through skills and ultimate. With the release of Rust, 6 weapons, 4 skills, 4 skill effects, and ultimate will be added. Rust can additionally activate skills through gold and acquire weapons through commissions just like the pre-existing mercenaries.

[b]3. Balance Adjustment [/b]
We will go through balance adjustments based on data analysis. Through this patch, we will ease the selection on mercenaries and weapons to allow more room for tactical gameplay.

We will strive to provide the best game environment possible and continue to listen to player feedback. We hope players look forward to the additional contents to come in the summer update!

Thank you.

Once the tournament begins, players who registered before the start of each round will be automatically matched into teams to proceed with the tournament. Matches follow a pre-announced schedule, with each round occurring every 20 minutes. 
Players earn 1 point per round if they win or if they are unmatched due to an odd number of participants. These players qualify for the next round. However, a loss or a draw results in elimination from the current tournament. 
To continue to the next round, players must register again before it starts. Teammates will be randomly matched from the remaining participants in each round. 
If there are not enough players to form two teams in a round, the remaining participants are all awarded one win, and the tournament ends. 

4. Tournament Reward
Rewards are distributed based on the number of wins earned during the tournament. Rank rewards are given to players ranking in 1st to 3rd, while a participation reward will be provided to all other players who did not receive 1st to 3rd place rewards.

notes.title: May 21, 2025 Developer’s Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries!
We’d like to thank everyone who continue to support the game and here is the new update information.

[b]1. Tournament System[/b]
We have developed a tournament system for those looking for higher levels of competition!
Now, players can compete against other players and receive special rewards exclusive to the tournament.
The tournament will be hosted on a regular basis in the global and Asia region and provide exclusive titles and various in-game rewards based on ranks.
Players can participate as a group of 3 or alone. Players do not need to register and can participate at the set time immediately.
The tournament will be carried out as real-time matchmaking. The team that wins will move on to the next round. The matches will continue until there is a final winner. We plan to reduce the wait time with each match.

[b]2. Spectator System[/b]
With the addition of custom mode, players could now freely select battleground and matches to play with friends. We will add spectator mode to the system.
This will allow players to watch other players to learn tips and tricks or enjoy watching great plays.

3. New Team Deathmatch Map
A new map will be added to Team Deathmatch. This will require players to adjust to a new playstyle and allow players to have fun finding a new tactic. Also, this map will introduce “Environment Kill Zone” such as cliffs or holes where players could fall and die. Pushing enemies into the kill zone will allow the team to acquire score, increasing the tactical gameplay level and the intensity of game. Enjoy a new form of battle in a new map!

We’ll be back with more interesting contents and systems.
Thank you.

Consecutive kill message revision, shield weapon improvement, and conquest activation time display, and other various improvements are in preparation as well. We will disclose more details in the future announcements.

 The new player tutorial guide will be further adjusted and improved before it is released. It will not be updated on this patch. We thank players for their patience and look forward to the updates and improvements to be delivered.

notes.title: April 23, 2025 Developer’s Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries! 

  A new season has begun. Up until now, the dev team has focused on improving the game to fit the top-down tactical shooter gameplay by adjusting the match rules and combat system. We have also worked to prepare contents that players could enjoy playing. We plan to discuss the next updates this month as well through the developer’s notes.

[b]1. Custom Match[/b]
  The Matches and Matchmaking Battleground have been automatically matching players based on MMR (Match Making Rate). Players will now be able to play matches and matchmaking battleground with friends. We will provide more options that are not currently available through consistent updates. We will also bring spectator mode in the future. 

[b]2. Congratulation System[/b]
  A congratulation system will be added that checks and mentions player rank changes. The congratulation system will allow players to better their understanding of gameplay. The system will notify rank changes and congratulate players on their rank improvements.
 
[b]3. New Player Content Guide[/b]
  A system will be added so that new mercenaries can understand and adapt to the game. We will develop the system so that players can learn the game through achieving goals and receiving rewards.
 
[b]4. Weapon Improvement[/b]
  To address the issue where certain weapons are useful at start but fall off as the game progresses, we will be improving the value of weapons that generate shields. weapons such as Tau’s ‘Sturdy Shield’ and Urth’s ‘Safe Zone’ will be included in such improvements. The defensive capabilities will depend on the mercenary’s growth.
   Yuni’s weapon ‘Pulse Gun’ and ‘Tempest’ will have it’s attack system changed to hit-scan. Yuni’s gameplay style is to catch an opportunity to quickly close the gap and deal great damage in a short time.  With hit-scan on certain weapons, Yuni’s combat style will be more pronounced. 
  
  In this update, we plan to bring revamps, improvements, and new contents to make the shooter game more fun and enjoyable. We hope that players continue to support our game and will strive to bring abundant updates.

Thank  you.

notes.title: March 26, 2025 Developer’s Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries!

  We’d like to inform players of the major updates coming in April. In April, we will be starting service in KOG Games as well as launching the webpage for Return Alive. We also plan to start the new season with various contents. We thank everyone for your continued support and here are the details below.

1. Start of Direct Service and Launch of Webpage
  Starting in April, we will be starting our service through the Global Publisher, KOG Games Portal. As a company that has been publishing games in America, Europe, and Asia for over 15 years, we believe this is a great opportunity for us to reach out to a bigger pool of players all over the world and reach out to players who would be interested in our new games. We will be providing cross-platform gameplay like Steam and Epic Store players, thus improving the matchmaking system for all.
Login will be made through the KOG Games Return Alive Webpage. Announcements will be made through the Return Alive Webpage as well. The webpage is scheduled to open in April.


2. Season 3 Start
  Congratulations! A title reward will be sent to all high-ranking mercenaries who have made great achievements during the last season. We hope players will strive to greater heights in the new season as well. With the start of the new season, we will bring new contents to the battle pass rewards. We also plan to provide a Legendary Battlesuit that was not available in other seasons, so don’t miss the chance!

3. Battle Improvement
  To provide fair and fun battle, we will go through Balance Patch, Weapon Improvement, and Ultimate Styling. We hope that the changes to the base meta will provide a more fun and tactical battle to all players.

4. New Contents
  A new map will be added to Payload Push. With new themes, you can go through more tactical battles. Also, a new Rush Battleground Map will be added. The Marshland Rush Battleground Map will provide a new enjoyment completely separate from the original matchmaking battleground. We hope that players survive against ever-changing and powerful enemies and acquire the newly added Back Ornament reward.

  We continue to collect player feedback even after the patches. If adjustments are needed, we will act swiftly to fill the needs of players. We continue to provide many enjoyments through our updates. We hope players look forward to the future fun that we plan to bring and continue to support our game. We will strive to bring the best experience possible in Return Alive.

  Thank you.

Conquest Match Rules will be changed to be based on rounds so that the players can gain advantages, overcome disadvantages, and have more fun out of the game format.

The format is changed from a single round to a best of 3 rounds.
Players will go through a maximum of 3 rounds. The team that wins 2 rounds or the team that has won more rounds at the end of all rounds will win the match.

Players can swap equipment after each round. The order of weapon swap will be based on the win/loss of the previous round. The team that lost the previous round can press the Tab key to check the equipment of the team that won the previous round during the Equipment Swap Period.

Hello, Mercenaries!

This month’s developer notes will cover the major updates on March. Last month, we have covered the roadmap of updates for 2025. Out of those updates, the title system and conquest rules will be applied first. New map, new armor, and many improvements will also be released. Please check the details below.

[b]1.	Title System[/b]
The Title System will be introduced. Titles allow players to display their achievements and hard work to other players. We will be adding various titles that require a great deal of time, great skill, or great luck. Titles will be broken into two parts: Prefix, Suffix. Players can combine the two to create their own titles. After the update, players can receive Season 1 Rank Titles through the exchange ticket that players have received.

[b]2.	Conquest Rule Change[/b]
Conquest Rules will be changed. A max total of 3 rounds will take place. The team that has achieved 100% conquest will win. At the end of the round, players can swap equipment based on the results of the previous round. This will allow the losing team to adjust to the winning team, allowing more tactical gameplay. Also, with the new rules, we will be adjusting the match time and match rules so that the gameplay doesn’t feel dragged out. This will only applied to the Conquest content in the update in March, but will be applied to other matches in the future.

[b]3.	New Map[/b]
A rush battleground with Abandoned Harbor as the background. The map has a lot of open space, providing wide vision. This will lead to an importance in tactical positioning with ranged combat. The destroyed containers and various machinery like cranes serve as terrains to add to the tactical gameplay. With various path options and ambush from the backline, choosing the path to attack and secure will be crucial in this map.
The Team Deathmatch map of marshlands has full of bushes in a compact area. Stealth and ambush play is key in this map. With limited vision and more opportunities for melee combat, teamfight and cooperation is key.

[b]4.	Other[/b]
New armor and the long-awaited Steam Achievements will be added. Also, UI appearances will be improved.

Us Return Alive Team are working hard to prepare for great updates to the game. Please look forward to the new content and updates we will bring in the future. We thank all players for their continued support and will continue to strive to create the best game experience possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: January 22, 2025 Developer’s Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries!

With the start of 2025, Return Alive has begun the year's new updates. Continuing from 2024, we plan to improve the game as a top-down tactical shooter and add more content. Here are some future developments. 

1. Title System
The title system will be introduced, providing a greater sense of achievement and more rewards. With the title system, players can cherish how hard they tried in the game content and can display their achievements to other players. The results of season 1 will be updated on February 5th, providing an item that can be exchanged for the title when the title system is released.

2. Best-of-3 system
To help players focus better, matches will now incorporate a best-of-3 system. Players can also swap weapons between rounds, allowing for more tactical gameplay.

3. Introducing 2 Weapon Types
Currently, players can select two weapons to equip without any limitations. Weapons will be broken into 2 types. One weapon slot will be for the offensive weapon type and the other slot for the special weapon type. We hope to bring in-depth gameplay through this change. 

4. New events within the battleground
We also plan to create more events within the battleground. Events such as monsters that pop out from stepping into certain areas to pose a threat to players or a mission that pops up to provide additional goals are within our radar in terms of development. Also, we plan to add more consumables so that it gives a different sense of experience for players, adding more layers to the gameplay. We will also attempt to find fun rules and level designs for matches that players can enjoy. 

Our goal is to continue the improvements and developments in content to perfect and smooth out the game. We will strive to continue improving systems that are not well received and add newly-themed modes, maps, and various systems.

We are doing our best to provide the best updates possible for mercenaries. The updates will be delivered at the earliest time possible. We hope players look forward to the updates we are preparing and wish a happy and bountiful new year of 2025. We will continue to ardor to provide the best possible experience. 

Thank you.
Return Alive Team.

The battleground has not just the available loot like the regular battleground, but also New Weapon Use Ticket, Legendary Grade Battlesuit, Back Ornament, and other various rewards available only in Rush Battleground.
Please check the details below regarding the Rush Battleground.

1. Entry Requirement: Mercenaries at a Rank Score of 150 or higher can enter. An entry ticket will be consumed upon entering. Entry Tickets can be purchased with 800 gold in the shop.
2. Match Time: There is no separate time limit in the battleground.
3. Escape: At a set interval, an escape chopper will arrive at a random location. The escape chopper will leave the battleground after a set time.
4. Oxygen: All mercenaries will receive a basic oxygen kit to conduct activities in the battleground. Running out of oxygen will inflict great damage at a set interval to the mercenary. Players may defeat other mercenaries or destroy Transported Supplies to get more oxygen.
5. Bounty Target: Mercenaries that have accumulated their notoriety by defeating other mercenaries will be marked as a Bounty Target. Bounty Target is ranked into 3 stages. Stage 3 Bounty Target will have their location revealed at a set interval of time. Defeating other bounty targets will reduce the notoriety stages.
6. Loot: Players can defeat monsters or explore to acquire various loot. Players can also defeat other mercenaries to receive unrefined energy from other mercenaries. To fully own the loot, players must successfully escape. Weapons, Armor, and other sale items will be calculated into gold. Special Module, Weapon Core Parts, Body Modification Materials, and Interactable Items will be sent to the storage.
7. Consumables: The battle supplies in the battleground contain consumables used in the old days. The consumables have various effects that may change the tide of battle. Due to the rules that govern the safe zone, consumables cannot be brought out of the battleground.
8. Reward: New rewards are available on top of the loot available in the regular battleground. Players can now acquire New Weapon Use Ticket, Legendary Grade Battlesuit, Back Ornament, and other various items exclusively available to Rush Battleground.

notes.title: January 15, 2025 Update Preview
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries!

In the update on January 15, 2025, season 2 will be updated.
With the new season, a Companion Growth Event will take place where players can play and grow together with their friends. Rush Battleground will be officially released and a new map ‘Shining Skyscraper’ will be added.

[b]1. Season 2 Update[/b]
Season 1 will end and a new season will begin. The new season will have Rank and Rank Rewards reset and new login rewards and Battle Pass will begin. Also, improvements to weapon balance and gameplay rewards will take place.

[b]2. Companion Growth Event Update[/b]
A growth event will take place where players can play with a friend and grow together. During the event period, players can enter partnerships with friends and play to gather Companion Growth Points and acquire Battlesuit, limited-time Emotes, and other various rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/662449e110425cdcdc302675ea48896bd0d125ac.png[/img]

[b]3. Rush Battleground Update[/b]
As introduced in the developer’s notes, the Rush Battleground will be officially released. Players can enter Rush Battleground on a real-time basis. Rush Battleground can be entered with entry tickets. Entry tickets can be purchased with gold.
In the official version, New Weapon Use Ticket, Legendary Grade Battlesuit, Back Ornament, and other various rewards that are exclusively available to Rush Battleground will be added.
Grow and gather loot in a battleground where powerful mercenaries who entered ahead await newcomers. Escape Safely from the battleground before the oxygen is depleted.

[b]4. New Battleground “Shining Skyscraper” Update[/b]
New Battleground “Shining Skyscraper” will be updated. With brand new themes, defeat new monsters in the new battleground and acquire various rewards. New battleground can be entered as Solo Battleground, Party Battleground, Solo Rush Battleground, and Party Rush Battleground.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/7a7a6b4f42cb933b353f6a6a3be44698574a1dcd.png[/img]
 
[b]5. Back Ornament Update[/b]
Back Ornament will be added to allow further customization for appearance along with the Battlesuit. The back ornament can be acquired by exchanging materials gathered in the Rush Battleground.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/2647f10b7db3bf0e87995d12f5632c0246ef1e49.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/b43910680a535308fe65128478ff78faeeef8b89.png[/img]

[b]6. 5 New Weapons Update[/b]
Each mercenary will have a new weapon that has a new place of acquisition. The new weapon cannot be permanently acquired and is only available through use tickets. New Weapon Use Tickets can only be acquired in the Rush Battleground.

[b]7. UI Improvement[/b]
UI Design Improvements will be made over multiple updates. UI improvements will be made starting from the January update with the lobby and will be done over time.

notes.title: December 25, 2024 Developer’s Notes
notes.content:
2 months have passed since the launch of Return Alive on Steam and a new season will begin next month. With the new season, the dev team is preparing new systems and various contents. We plan on updating Rush Battleground currently temporarily available as Winter Break Event to be a permanent content. 

The dev team plans to take player opinions and feedback as much as possible to create a battleground where players can test their luck and skill. Players will enter with no armor and will have to struggle against powerful mercenaries and monsters to claim the higher ground and farm loot.

The Rush Battleground can be started immediately without any waiting or matchmaking. However, players will need Entry Tickets to enter. Tickets can be bought with gold. Also, players will be able to acquire the Legendary Battlesuit and new Accessory items for looks as reward. 

With the addition of battlegrounds with new themes, new monsters will be added as well. The new monster Sky Fortress is an aerial titan boss that is structured to give a tense, pressuring battle with bullets flying everywhere and wide AOE attacks. With main patterns ranging from bullet barrage, defense reduction debuff, and missile bombardment that hits the entire boss zone. Players must react with precise movements and tactical planning. The boss is structured to be challenging but on a reasonable difficulty so that players will receive a sense of achievement. We will improve combat experience by continuing to respond to feedback.

We have received many precious opinions and feedbacks from players in the development of Rush Battleground. We have released this content as Winter Event first so we can see more areas where we can improve upon the official content update. We will continue to listen and communicate with players and strive to create the best experience possible.

Thank you.

[h3][Event Info][/h3]
A rush battleground will be added where players can enter without matchmaking. Play Rush Battleground to gather Event Currency to exchange for Event Emotes, Greeting Emojis, and other various limited time items.

[b]1. Rush Battleground Open[/b]
[b]Rush Battleground Entry Period: 
December 18, 2024 (Wed) After Maintenance – January 8, 2025 (Wed) 02:00 (UTC+0)[/b]

Play the Rush Battleground to gather Event Currency. Players can complete Battleground Achievements in the Rush Battleground. Also, equipment for the mercenary who entered the Rush Battleground will drop so that players can build armor much easily.

1) Survival Time
There is no separate survival time in the battleground.

2) Escape
The Escape Chopper will arrive at a random location on a set interval.
The Escape Chopper will leave the battleground after the set time has passed.

3) Oxygen
Mercenaries will be supplied with basic oxygen kit to allow them to be active in the battleground.
When the oxygen is depleted, the mercenary will take great damage at a set interval.
Defeating other mercenaries or destroying transported supplies will provide additional oxygen.

4) Bounty Target
Mercenaries will build notoriety upon killing other mercenaries. Upon reaching a set stage of notoriety, the mercenary will be marked as the Bounty Target.
The Bounty Target will be broken down into 3 stages based on the notoriety.
Bounty Targets at Stage 3 will have their location revealed at a set interval.
Defeating other Bounty Targets will reduce the notoriety.

5) Loot
Defeating monsters or exploring will allow players to acquire various loots.
Monsters and Loot Box will respawn after a set time.
Upon defeating other mercenaries, players can acquire the unrefined energy in their possession.
To fully claim the loot acquired in the battleground, players must successfully escape to safety.
Players can only acquire Event Currency and Armor from the Loot Box.

6) Consumables
The battle supplies in the battleground have the consumables used during the old times.
Consumables have various effects that can turn the tides of battle.
Consumables cannot be brought out of battlegrounds due to the rules of the safe zone.

notes.title: November 27, 2024 Developer’s Notes
notes.content:
Developer’s Notes
 
With the launch of the official season, Return Alive has completed the first patch. We have tried to reflect player opinion as much as possible and will continue to try our best to do so in the future.

Continuing on from the previous Developer’s Notes, we would like to share the decisions we have gone through based on player opinion and feedback.

[b]1. Focus on PVP[/b]
Return Alive puts an emphasis on PVP battle. Therefore, Return Alive has been aiming to provide fun through player competition. However, we also do take note that there are players who has a love for PVE content. There will be ‘Rush Battleground’ and New Battleground ‘Taskan’ for those who prefer PVE so that PVE and PVP players can all have fun. Please keep up with our news for details on future contents.
 
[b]2. Opinions on Unlocking Battleground[/b]
We have decided to take player opinions and allow players to enter Battleground without playing any matches.
 
[b]3. Opinion on the Deletion of Roll[/b]
Return Alive believes that decision and strategy is more crucial than gameplay controls of an individual. Therefore, we believe that most important part of gameplay is to use the walls and bushes strategically to react and interact with other players. If rolling gives great advantage in dodging enemy attacks, we believe that levelling doesn’t feel as rewarding since people can simply roll to dodge attacks. Also, dodging easily will cause players to not take note of the weapons and movements of their enemies and focus more on dodging rather than actual offensive play. This will cause the game to all revolve around rolling and dodging, which we believe as too shallow in terms of gameplay. In order to improve this issue, we have removed rolling after great consideration. 
 
[b]4. Slow Combat Tempo[/b]
Return Alive serves to improve the fun in gameplay through reactions. In order to react to enemy attacks, players must realize where the trajectory is coming from to dodge or block. We have adjusted movement speed and attack speed to meet the reaction time for such gameplay. Faster combat tempo would mean less time to react and more things happening simultaneously. We have made this development choice to give players room for more options in gameplay. However, we do recognize that many players feel uncomfortable with the movement speed, so we plan to make improvements on this system in the future. We will continue to strive to improve the gameplay.
 
[b]5. Additional Improvements to Combat and Weapon[/b]
Many players have sent us opinions and feedback on the delay in use of weapons, spin speed, and aim changes. The delay in the use of weapon is applied to all players equally, and develop their own skills in combat. For non-swappable weapons like Bombardment Launcher, we have updated the bullets so that each bullet will be fired at the aim through the update on November 20th. We will continue to adjust the weapon balance and will improve weapons that players find problematic. Please continue to provide us with opinions and feedback.
 
[b]6. Problems with Bots in PVP Modes[/b]
We are trying to increase the player pool and also at the same time, to improve bots. We will also introduce a new mode where players can go into without waiting for other players. Players can enter at any size to contest their luck and skill with each other. We are also looking more into party play and will come up with events regarding multiplayer gameplay. Please continue to watch out for future announcements for more information.
 
[b]7. Player Party Matchmaking Improvements[/b]
The dev team has had the same concerns as the players. The dev team is looking into giving players the option of either getting matched with bots or other players. We will bring this system in within the first quarter of 2025 at the latest.

[b]8. Accumulated Commission Point Improvements[/b]
There have been some requests on capping Commission Point for players who have already completed all commissions. We have left this part out for now since we will continue to update weapons in the future, but we will think about how we will handle this to help players gain commission points for other characters as well.
 
[b]9. Request to add Steam Achievements[/b]
To answer this request, we will be adding Steam Achievements within the first quarter of 2025.

Finally, we’d like to thank Xylon, empdavid, 7LA4D, Hurtbringer, Merkabich, EvilTwin, RadeonProVega, and many other players who have given us player opinion and feedback.

The Return Alive team will strive to create a better game experience.
Thank you.

notes.title: November 1, 2024 Developer Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Mercenaries!

 First and foremost, we’d like to thank everyone who has taken an interest in Return Alive and continues 
to play to this day. The ‘Return Alive’ team will actively communicate with players to receive player opinions and improve the game based on the feedback.

 Ever since the update on October 23, we have received many player opinions and suggestions below. We’d like to explain the reasoning behind our decisions and improve the issues that we believe should be updated.

 Issues with Forced Match Gameplay – The dev team has taken note of this issue and is working to reduce the playtime in matches required to unlock the battleground and apply the changes during the maintenance on November 6. Even after the update, we will find other means to improve the situation if we continue to see that this is an issue. Since every mode includes some sort of PVP gameplay, we believe players should go through Tutorial and lighter content to get used to various characters and weapons before going into deeper content.

 Removal of Roll – Return Alive emphasizes PVP. We also believe that a crucial part of PVP lies in creating opportunities and using those opportunities to bring down the enemies. The reason why roll has been removed is because it easily nullifies the opportunity that the player worked hard to create. We believe that creating an opportunity is a crucial part of having fun in the game. We hope that players will have fun by improving their skills and by making use of the opportunities that they create.

 Fixed Weapon System by Character – The reason why we have fixed the weapons to be used by each character is to create differences between the characters in terms of combat. By creating these differences, players can expect and react in a certain manner. The Return Alive team plans to provide fun in gameplay by placing the focus on recognizing the enemy’s weapons and reacting to the character build. Also, the weapon restriction allows the characters to display strengths and weaknesses better and allows us to develop weapons that specialize with the characters.

 Reward Acquisition Limit in Battlegrounds – We are in the process of adjusting the difficulty of the battleground. We may update the limit once we finish the difficulty adjustment. The current limit serves to put a restriction on acquiring rewards endlessly while the difficulty is low.

 Battleground Reward Changed to Gold – In the previous update, we introduced licenses into the game. Because of this, we have changed the rewards to Gold in the Battleground. Other than that, we believe that the process of selling the lesser items acquired is unnecessarily long. We have reduced this process so that players will directly receive Gold instead of sellable items.

 Confusion in the Changes to Game Genre – Return Alive has gone through big changes to provide fun content. We thank everyone for going with us during this process. We will provide various modes, maps, weapons, and characters along with consistent updates to content.

   Slot Difference in Shop Avatar and Game Avatar – Since the Shop Avatar is of higher rank, there are differences in slots. We will be providing some opportunities to acquire the Legendary Battlesuit purely through gameplay in the future.

   Character Purchase System Issues – Characters will be available as cash purchases for 2 weeks upon release. After 2 weeks have passed, characters will be available with Gold purchase in the Shop. Tau can be purchased with Gold after the maintenance on November 6.

   Yuni Character Performance Drop – We thank players who have taken great interest in Yuni. With the official season release, characters now have more emphasis on their strengths and weaknesses. We cannot guide players in how the gameplay is done, but we believe players can overcome the weaknesses and emphasize the strengths, creating gameplay exclusive to Yuni. We will be updating and improving weapons that are lacking in future updates. Please continue to enjoy the game.

   Issues with Matchmaking – We are actively working to get more players into the game. We hope that players continue to enjoy Return Alive.

   Mismatch in Trailer and Actual Gameplay – We know that players are surprised that the gameplay appears different than the ‘Battleground’ trailer. The Trailer that players have watched is based on the mode ‘Battleground’. Players can enter the battleground after playing Matches for a certain game time. After the update on November 6, we plan to reduce the playtime required so that players can enjoy ‘Battleground’ earlier.

   Running Out of Ammunition – Ammunition in Return Alive is directly correlated to attack opportunities. Each bullet corresponds to an opportunity. In the case of Ned’s assault rifle, players may stop the attack, but the bullets fired will not be returned. This applies to every player so that players have to think about the cost and return and leave room for gameplay improvements. If players wish to try out a character that fires bullets 1 by 1, we suggest that players try out the character ‘Elvacia’ which can be purchased in the shop with Gold.
 
   It is difficult to bring all the changes requested quickly, but we are looking over improvements in various ways. We will strive to bring improvements to the game so that players can enjoy the game more. We will take note of player opinions and work hard to create a fun game: ‘Return Alive’.
 
   We will continue to provide information on updates and patch notes in the future. ‘Return Alive’ values opinions and feedback from mercenaries and we hope to continue developing the game. We’d like to thank everyone again and ask players to continue to provide opinions and feedback.

‘Return Alive’ Team

notes.content:

Hello Mercenaries,

We are excited to welcome players joining the mercenary guild of Kairos and beginning their journey in Return Alive. With this Global CBT, we hope to gather feedback for the official release of the game as well as test the game’s technical aspects, such as bug testing, server stability, and more. 

The Global CBT will run on Steam from [b]7:00 UTC+0 Thursday June 29, 2023, until 7:00 UTC+0 Friday July 7, 2023.[/b] We thank you for all your support and participation during this period.

If you are interested in joining the Global CBT, simply request access to the CBT on our store page on Steam. Once you have signed up, you will be able to gain access to the CBT.


[h3]Official Platforms[/h3]
To keep up to date with Return Alive’s news and updates during our Global CBT period and further, make sure you follow our social media channels and Discord below.

•  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1818010/Return_Alive/]Steam[/url]
•  [url=https://www.facebook.com/ReturnAlive.KOG/]Facebook[/url]
•  [url=https://www.instagram.com/returnalivekog/]Instagram [/url]
•  [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Returnalive]YouTube[/url]
•  [url=https://discord.gg/returnalive]Discord[/url]


[h3]FAQ[/h3]
[b][Q]: When is the Global CBT (Closed Beta Test) Period Running?[/b]

[A]: The Global CBT Period will run from June 29, 2023 (Thu) 07:00 (UTC+0) until July 7, 2023 (Fri) 07:00 (UTC+0).


[b][Q] How can I access the Global CBT?[/b]

[A] The CBT can be accessed by signing up on our game’s Steam Store page and clicking the Request Access button. Once you have signed up, you will be able to gain access to the game.


[b][Q]: What Content will be available in the Global CBT?[/b]

[A]: We will have three playable characters for players to choose from (Ned, Yuni, and Urth) along with many character enhancing systems. For PVE, we will have two battlegrounds (PVP and Non-PVP Options) available for players to explore: Zeliarde and Valtan (Glasstone Desert only). For PVP, we will have Survival, and Solo Deathmatch modes available.


[b][Q]: Will progress from the Global CBT carry over into the official release?[/b]

[A]: Data and progress from the Global CBT will be wiped after the test has concluded and will not carry over to the official release.


[b][Q]: Can I stream or capture gameplay during the Global CBT?[/b]

[A]: Yes! Participants in the Global CBT are not tied to an NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement), so they may stream, record, clip, or screenshot the game as much as they like. If you do create content, make sure to tag us on social media (Or use the hashtag #ReturnAlive) or share it in our Discord so we can see it too!


[b][Q]: My friend is also participating in the Global CBT. Can I play with them?[/b]

[A]: Yes! While in the lobby, pressing one of the + icons next to your character will allow you to search for your friend’s in-game name to add to your party and to your friend’s list as well.


[b][Q]: What languages are available in the Global CBT?[/b]

[A]: We will have two language options available for players: Korean and English


[b][Q]: I’m having issues with the game/encountered a bug I’d like to report/would like to share some feedback for the game. Where could I do that?[/b]

[A]: We have a Bug Report channel and a Feedback channel on our [url=https://discord.gg/returnalive]Official Discord[/url] for players to report any issues they’re experiencing. or improvements they may have. For bug reports, please include as much detail as possible including any screenshots or videos to help aid us in fixing it.

notes.title: 리턴 얼라이브 CBT가 종료되었습니다.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/bf51b34e33e2e6135b31007852ea8d4c99f3e177.jpg[/img]

안녕하세요.
리턴 얼라이브입니다.

리턴 얼라이브 첫 CBT가 종료되었습니다.
여러분의 성원에 힘입어 10일간의 테스트를 무사히 마칠 수 있었습니다.

리턴 얼라이브 CBT에 참여해 주신 테스터 분들께 감사드립니다.
리턴 얼라이브는 여러분들이 보내주신 모든 격려와 충고를 포함한 모든 의견을 소중하게 생각하고 있습니다.
이번 테스트에서 주신 의견을 하나하나 경청하여 장점은 더 살리고 부족한 부분은 다듬어 완성도를 높일 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠습니다.

현재 이후 컨텐츠도 개발 중에 있으니 다음 테스트도 참여해 주시어 발전된 리턴 얼라이브의 모습을 지켜봐 주세요.

CBT를 재미있게 즐기셨다면 스팀 스토어에서 저희 리턴 얼라이브를 찜목록에 추가 부탁드리겠습니다.
다음 테스트에서 꼭 다시 만나 뵙기를 희망합니다 .

감사합니다.

notes.title: 리턴 얼라이브는 주말 동안 24시간 오픈됩니다.
notes.content:
안녕하세요
리턴 얼라이브입니다.

하루에 6시간만 테스트를 진행해서 불편하셨으리라 생각됩니다.

12시에 종료되는 것을 아쉬워하시는 분들이 많으시고 시간이 맞지 않아 접속 못하시는 분들도 계실것으로 생각되어 오늘부터 테스트 종료 전까지 유저분들이 원하는 시간에 편하게 접속하실 수 있도록 24시간 오픈해두고 점검이 필요한 경우 전날 미리 공지 드리고 점검을 진행하려고 합니다. 

■ 수정된 한국 CBT 일정 안내
테스트 기간 2022년 02월 25일 18:00 ~ 2022년 03월 04일 23:59


앞으로도 여러분들의 의견에 귀 기울이는 개발팀이 되겠습니다.
남은 기간동안도 재미있게 플레이 해주세요.

감사합니다.

notes.title: 2월 24일 클라이언트 패치 내용 안내 드립니다.
notes.content:
안녕하세요.
리턴 얼라이브입니다.

어제 많은 플레이어분들이 재미있게 플레이 해주셔서 감사합니다.
개발팀에서는 여러분들의 의견을 하나하나 소중하게 읽어보고 있습니다.

팀에서 급하게 수정이 필요하다고 판단되는 버그 수정 패치를 진행하였습니다.


[h2][2.24 패치 내역][/h2]

1. 랜덤 파티 매칭 시 무단 이탈 할경우 일일 이탈 횟수에 따라 30초 ~ 300초까지 전장/모드에 입장할 수 없는 패널티가 동작하지 않던 문제가 수정됩니다. 이제부터 파티원의 동의 없이 이탈할 경우 일정 시간동안 전장/모드 입장이 제한됩니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/675ad567875a455fcb1908426f042539016a0814.png[/img]


2. 월드맵(M키)에서 마우스 우클릭으로 핑을 찍으면 해당 위치로 가는 네비게이션이 동작하지 않던 문제가 수정됩니다. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/3b9fc0bc8b3d47138e452aa077766d348d0c8c1f.png[/img]


3. 인트로 로고 출력 시 사운드가 너무 크다는 의견들이 있어서 볼륨이 조정됩니다. 


버그 수정과는 별도로 여러분들의 의견들에 대해 개발팀의 답변을 드리는 시간을 가지려고 합니다.
우선 매력적인 무기를 획득하는 것에 관심이 많으실 것 같아서 가지고 싶은 무기의 획득처를 알아보는 방법을 별도의 공지로 알려드리려고 합니다.
자세한 방법은 아래의 링크를 클릭해서 확인해 보세요.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1818010/view/3091162528099143425


이외에도 몬스터 수가 부족하다거나 유저들과 너무 자주 만난다는 의견도 많이 있었습니다. 해당 의견은 아직 게임에 익숙하지 않아 많은 플레이어 분들이 초보 존에만 머무르고 있어서 생기는 의견으로 보입니다. 해당 의견은 조금 더 지켜보고 조정하도록 하겠습니다.

오늘 테스트도 재미있게 플레이 부탁드립니다.

감사합니다.

notes.title: 리턴 얼라이브 팁! 갖고 싶은 무기의 획득처를 알아보자.
notes.content:
리턴 얼라이브 CBT에 참여해 주신 용병단 여러분들 감사합니다!
클로즈 베타 테스트 2일 차가 되었습니다.

첫날 플레이로 많은 용병단 여러분들이 리턴 얼라이브의 매력적인 무기들에 관심이 많아졌을 것 같습니다.
이 무기 갖고 싶은데, 도대체 설계도는 어디서 나오는 거야?!라고 궁금해하셨을 것 같아 작은 팁 하나를 공유해 드리려고 합니다.

[h3]팁 1. [/h3]무기 설계도의 획득처를 찾는 법

1. 제작 > 무기 제작에서 가지고 싶은 무기를 선택합니다.

2. 해당 무기의 설계도 설명에 [획득처]가 표시되어 있습니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/2c2a198ad115df8a41501bf3bf37d2ba96f0bd69.png[/img]

3. 전장 월드맵(M키) / 임무 월드맵을 마우스 휠로 확대한 후 각 지역에 마우스를 올리면 해당 지역에 등장하는 몬스터를 확인할 수 있습니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/733baab6da4199e1a5811f5cf52bcc6e150040cb.png[/img]

4. 월드맵에서 내가 찾고 있는 몬스터의 이름을 찾아보세요.

5. 해당 지역으로 이동해 해당 몬스터를 처치하고 설계도를 획득해 보세요. 

[h3]팁 2.[/h3] 엘리트/보스 몬스터의 경우, 전장에서 몬스터 탐지(Tab키)로 생존 여부를 확인할 수 있습니다.
엘리트 몬스터의 경우, 등장 지역 인근에 가야만 몬스터 탐지기에서 해당 몬스터의 생존 여부를 확인할 수 있습니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/672e0bc230b821b97f281271ec6ca94159026a5e.png[/img]

notes.title: 리턴 얼라이브 CBT 시작 안내(수정)
notes.content:

리턴 얼라이브입니다.

여러분들이 기다리시던 리턴 얼라이브 CBT가 오늘 오후 6시에 시작될 예정입니다.
현재까지 한국에서 신청하신 분들은 모두 테스터로 선정될 예정이며 선정 즉시 라이브러리에 '리턴 얼라이브 CBT'가 추가됩니다.

notes.title: [무기 소개]CBT 기간 획득 가능한 무기 소개
notes.content:
안녕하세요
리턴 얼라이브입니다.

이번에는 CBT를 플레이하면서 획득할 수 있는 여러 무기들 중 일부를 소개해보고자 합니다.

[h2]만월[/h2]

무기 설명: 루나틱 사우리페스의 결정에 잠재되어 있는 에너지를 전방으로 사출할 수 있도록 만들어진 무기.
모든 물체를 분자 단위까지 분해해버리는 무시무시한 광선을 쏟아낼 수 있다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/284bf1c232e0444db9b6324b01659ab964ec4a01.png[/img]

제조사: 에볼라

기본 공격: 전방으로 총기에 응축된 에너지를 발사합니다. 에너지에 닿은 적에게 50의 피해를 입힙니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/d92d9e47a7345a6bb7f8822dd8e8d74d3caf85f7.gif[/img]

특수 공격: 전방으로 총기에 응축된 강력한 에너지를 발사합니다. 에너지에 닿은 적에게 96의 피해를 입힙니다. 타격한 적에게 죽음의 공포를 부여합니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/8a4aa7771002c02f71ecff7cd7f15726d1ee6d89.gif[/img]



[h2]스토커[/h2]

무기 설명: 젤리아드 지역에서 서식하는 스토커계열 뮤테리온들의 여왕 아라크네아의 결정을 탑재한 무기.
내부에 있는 스토커의 알을 사출한 뒤 아라크네아의 결정에서 나오는 호르몬을 이용하여 데스 스토커를 부화시키고 조종할 수 있다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/e90228a42407447d03db18844b56a4b0a0225712.png[/img]

제조사: 에볼라

기본 공격: 지정된 위치로 거미줄을 발사합니다. 거미줄 범위 내에있는 적들은 이동속도가 50% 감소하고 0.25초 간격으로 80의 피해를 입습니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/6552a28b835c0cb2899456e2bfd4c1a1b996a287.gif[/img]

특수 공격: 지정된 위치에 데스 스토커를 소환하는 알을 설치합니다. 알에 적이 접근했을 경우 데스 스토커가 부화하며 적에게 달려들어 자폭합니다. 스토커는 폭발하며 주변에 400의 피해를 입힙니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/7c1046f92db1af7063cdf4b7b3f08b37d124aa75.gif[/img]



[h2]영광[/h2]

무기 설명: 대몰락 이전의 기술을 일부 계승하는 장거리 소총. 어떤 구조로 작동되는지 알 수 없으나 총 내부에서 생성되는 에너지를 플라즈마 형태로 방출한다. 강력한 공격력과 우월한 사거리로 초장거리 전투에 특화되어 있는 무기다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/f030251c12af1d12a2fd3c10d321cd18ff9b2577.png[/img]

제조사: 아스트라

기본 공격: 거리에 비례하여 300~600 피해를 입히는 빔형태의 탄환을 발사합니다. 먼거리의 적을 적중 시 더 많은 피해를 입힙니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/fa73209b9f50eb26e79687b8b3caef7d707fbe1e.gif[/img]

특수 공격: 응축된 에너지를 전방으로 발사하여 피격한 대상에게 1200 피해를 입힙니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/0eb9cbc8d5402c67d1b388105f20474678e15a2d.gif[/img]



[h2]유령 무희[/h2]

무기 설명: 이 총을 들고 있으면 자연스럽게 아름답고 우아한 춤사위를 주변에 뽑낼 수 있다. 하지만 아름다웠다고 생각했던 우아한 춤사위가 거미줄에 걸린채 발버둥 치는 추한 몸부림이었다는 것을 알기까지는 그리 긴 시간이 걸리지 않을 것이다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/63a43454d39cf959806dd62a65941f427bdc1cfc.png[/img]

제조사: 아스트라

기본 공격: 전방으로 125의 피해를 입히는 연사공격을 가합니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/2bc9fb9a0eb67ef2e79a9573680ab5e726a2a845.gif[/img]

특수 공격: 주변으로 탄을 난사합니다. 주변으로 퍼지는 탄은 거리에 비례하여 26~128 피해를 입힙니다. 먼거리의 적을 적중 시 더 많은 피해를 입힙니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/d5e32bd11e7dbd58ca29a8b85117d33493aad4d9.gif[/img]



[h2]자유[/h2]

무기 정보: 대몰락 이전의 기술을 일부 계승하는 경량형 권총. 어떤 구조로 작동되는지는 알 수 없으나 총 내부에서 생성되는 에너지를 플라즈마 형태로 방출한다. 빠른 탄속과 가벼운 무게를 중심으로 고속 근접 전투에 특화되어 있는 무기다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/de4846b9a22af1f208d8a8e6f399b10902f89c4c.png[/img]

제조사: 아스트라

기본 공격: 전방으로 120 피해를 주는 빔형태의 탄환을 좌우 각각 3발씩 발사합니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/41e8e3966688924cc90cd9b4f8fdc51da8ee98c0.gif[/img]

특수 공격: 전방으로 46~150 피해를 주는 빔형태의 탄을 난사하여 일대를 초토화 시킵니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/a3471a6139418f00c6f3aadd9ce6e0f758f30b50.gif[/img]



[h2]전쟁의흉터[/h2]

무기 정보: 소형 로켓포를 전방으로 발사하여 공격하는 무기. 총구에서 쏟아지는 압도적인 화력은 지형 자체에 '흉터'를 남길만큼 무시무시하다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/bfe69840e209621219b5050a5546ad54de2172c9.png[/img]

제조사: 새비지

기본 공격: 전방에 세발의 탄환을 발사합니다. 탄환이 폭발하면 주변에 340의 피해를 입힙니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/ad85362aaf63fb56fa06719ad4182c6cde1171fe.gif[/img]

특수 공격: 전방으로 200의 피해를 입히는 많은 탄은 난사합니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/0032a4f36017558ceda0b06fbe0265bc53a1eecc.gif[/img]



[h2]최고의친구[/h2]

무기 정보: 구역에 침입하는 적을 감지하는 기능이 탁월한 듀얼 건 프라울러의 코어를 활용한 무기. 아군과 적을 기가 막히게 구분하는 지뢰와 터렛을 설치하여 특정 구역을 사수하는데 특화되어 있다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/876eaa0a863398d196109d27bc4e23d4a8488daf.png[/img]

제조사: 새비지

기본 공격: 지정된 위치로 지뢰를 발사합니다. 지뢰는 상대방에게 보이지 않으며, 접촉 시 폭팔하며 300의 피해를 입힙니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/b4e1d4599077e82ac421df87aa81dc490dc99f7f.gif[/img]

특수 공격: 지정된 위치에 공격형 터렛을 설치합니다. 터렛은 적에게 220의 피해를 입히는 탄을 발사합니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/fb61d7666590512fd8a45fbcbfad4fc6a51b0bca.gif[/img]



[h2]협상의달인[/h2]

무기 정보: 중요한 협상을 앞두고 별다른 협상 카드가 없을때 사용할 수 있는 매우 유용한 총기. 협상 자리에서 이 총에 장전되어 있는 총알을 몇발씩 제거하는 대가로 상대의 양보를 끌어낼 수 있다. 장탄수는 충분할 정도록 넉넉하기 때문에 협상이 불리하게 돌아갈 걱정은 접어두어도 좋다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/4549c48220704631f1e502009076b575ba9460b1.png[/img]

제조사: 새비지

기본 공격: 두개의 총구에서 빠른 연사 공격을 시전합니다. 공격에 타격된 적은 32~71의 피해를 줍니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/2833eeb3ebc8c19a86833bfd020518db7f0c45c7.gif[/img]

특수 공격: 총알을 난사하여 주변 일대를 초토화 시킵니다. 홀딩 시 최대 2.5초 동안 공격 유지 가능하며 24~65의 피해를 줍니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/5fae546cd5d31bd717737f4cd203849919f3b45d.gif[/img]



[h2]화염방사기[/h2]

무기 정보: 파이어 볼의 인화성 물질과 점화기로 만들어낸 거대한 불꽃을 전방으로 쏟아내는 무기. 단순히 화염을 발사할 뿐만 아니라 특수 가공 처리된 구체를 투척하여 투척된 장소에 불지대를 형성할 수도 있다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/6c26ee7d2404a4b135dd1336d5af79e7e1bbdb75.png[/img]

제조사: 새비지

기본 공격: 거리에 비례하여 38~50의 피해를 입히는 화염탄을 발사합니다. 가까운 적을 적중 시 더 많은 피해를 입힙니다. 화염탄에 적중된 적은 초당 100의 피해를 받는 화상 디버프가 생성되며, 디버프는 2초 동안 유지됩니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/9b982a3c957989ee36c0ff52ab65aabed66ddcff.gif[/img]

특수 공격: 지정한 위치로 불이 잘붙는 연료를 투척합니다. 투척된 자리에는 화염지대가 5초간 생성되며 0.5초 간격으로 350의 피해를 입힙니다. 불길에 적중된 적은 초당 100의 피해를 받는 화상 디버프가 생성되며, 디버프는 2초 동안 유지됩니다.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/bf57cc2370ca6692d37c3d21e312ec3707902aec.gif[/img]


이번에 소개한 무기들 외에도 수십종의 무기가 준비되어 있습니다. 
리턴 얼라이브 CBT를 플레이하면서 다양하고 매력적인 무기들을 직접 획득해 보세요.

notes.title: [전장 소개]전장 젤리아드 소개
notes.content:
안녕하세요. 
리턴 얼라이브입니다.    

이번에는 전장 콘텐츠의 주 무대인 젤리아드 지역에 대한 정보를 소개하려고 합니다. 
젤리아드 지역은 우른 호수 외곽에 있는 물의 도시 헤이븐과 그 인근 지역으로 구성되어 있습니다. 
물의 도시 헤이븐은 작은 항구를 가지고 있는 소규모 도시로 주변 농가에서 수확한 식량들로 자급자족하며 살아갔던 도시입니다. 특히 도시 내부에 흐르고 있는 아름다운 수로가 유명했었다고 합니다.

그저 아름답고 작은 도시로 기록 되어 있었던 헤이븐이지만 최근 헤이븐 주변으로 군사 시설과 고대의 연구시설들이 발견되면서 오랜 시간 감춰져 왔었던 비밀들이 속속들이 밝혀지고 있습니다.

젤리아드는 크게 4개의 지역으로 구성되어 있습니다.  

[h2]폐허의 도시[/h2] 

작은 항구로 들어온 가지각색의 물품들과 그 물품들의 거래가 활발하게 이루어졌던 갈가마귀 시장을 중심으로 나름대로 번성했었던 소도시입니다. 수백 년간 방치되어 모든 건물들이 낡고 오래되었습니다. 항구 주위로 방치되어 망가진 배들의 모습이 보입니다.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/5c2d1524117c6b3d18580802db64e9df831a121c.png[/img]
<폐허의 도시 전겅 1>  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/c3e6d26d288c023716599f66aa642d90f0407b68.png[/img] 
<폐허의 도시 전경 2>  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/090cb05d7f7501c6be5de39f582ff7080fb6ec52.png[/img]
<폐허의 도시 지역 보스: 페르세스>





 [h2]보이지 않는 습지[/h2] 

과거에는 비옥한 농경지였으나 수백 년간 방치되어 습지로 변해버린 지역입니다. 검은 안개에 의해 변이해버린 뮤테리온들의 주 서식지입니다.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/17fb2b842b68b280e44180e81c24bb5ac2feafef.png[/img] 
<보이지 않는 습지 전경 1> 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/e81e3fe851e68ffa7c071ce6c6c11143ddc3063f.png[/img] 
<보이지 않는 습지 전경 2>  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/15eb0d630e30d7b00b99ade460865ca8ce46dfa2.png[/img]
<보이지 않는 습지 지역 보스: 기간티아>  





[h2]전쟁의 흉터[/h2] 

치열했던 전쟁의 흔적이 아직도 흉터처럼 남아있는 장소입니다. 곳곳에 골격만 남은채 방치되어 있는 군사 건물과 망가진 전쟁 병기들의 잔해가 남아있습니다. 젤리아드 지역의 북쪽에서부터 유입된 티탄들에게 점령되어 그들의 주 거점으로 사용되고 있습니다.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/f17a08aad7f122460c320f463a17e00bb8d64b3c.png[/img] 
<전쟁의 흉터 전경 1> 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/50e0684c842f5c6ed07ddf2ea794ecaa259ebd41.png[/img]
<전쟁의 흉터 지역 보스: 크라토스>   





[h2]여왕의 처소[/h2] 

 스토커계열 뮤테리온들의 여왕인 아라크네아와 그 자식들의 서식지입니다. 최근 여왕의 처소 깊숙한 곳에서 고대 연구시설이 발견되었으나 아직까지 해당 시설에서 무엇을 연구했었는지는 파악하지 못하고 있습니다.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/a708befbfe929afa5e4b2fb39882f8d965a5863a.png[/img] 
<여왕의 처소 전경 1>  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/659f127c4d989fea14bb430f04eaa1ad81c2ae71.png[/img] 
<여왕의 처소 전경 2>  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/35d25073cdd4e8e51c2d2049da3eaa5f7f3cc3d9.png[/img]
<여왕의 처소 지역 보스: 아라크네아>

notes.title: [용병 소개] CBT 참가 용병 소개[네드, 유니, 어스(M-224)]
notes.content:
안녕하세요.
리턴 얼라이브입니다.

앞으로 스팀 공지를 통해 여러분들이 궁금해하실 게임 정보를 공개하려고 합니다. 
첫 번째로, 여러분들이 이번 CBT 기간 동안 직접 플레이할 수 있는 다양한 용병들을 소개합니다.


[h3][b]1. 네드 / 카로스 족[/b][/h3]
″건전한 육체에 건전한 전투력이 깃든다.″

네드는 카이로스에서 나고 자란 24세의 건장한 카로스족 용병입니다.
매사에 진지한 태도를 유지하는 네드는
평소에도 자신의 신체를 단련하는데 여념이 없으며,
그 무엇보다 자신의 잘 단련된 육체를 자랑스럽게 생각합니다.

단련된 신체에서 나오는 강인함과 꾸준한 전투 훈련에서 나오는
완벽한 전투법이야 말로 버려진 땅에서 네드가 활약할 수 있는 원동력입니다.

[b]커스텀 그레네이드[/b] Active Skill
지정된 위치로 수류탄을 투척합니다.
넓은 범위에 피해를 입힙니다.

[b]퓨리[/b] Passive Skill
용병 스킬 사용 시 10초 간 공격력이 10% 증가합니다.


일반 배틀 슈트
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/c21ae1ba7cd0f985178c7a37a8a3dc926d6ea56d.png[/img]

희귀 배틀 슈트
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/0e2ba37ad257877f1053e562f5e9c0ecd2652976.png[/img]

영웅 배틀 슈트
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/a7129444bd411e012258789df3a3f32010d7e2e9.png[/img]



[h3][b]2. 유니 / 로이 족[/b][/h3]
″빨리, 빨리! 아이… 왜 이렇게 느린거야!″

발랄하고 활발한 성격의 유니는 21세의 로이족 용병입니다.
어렸을 적부터 명석한 두뇌를 가지고 태어난 유니는
항상 또래보다 빠르게 생각하고 빠르게 행동하는 모습을 보여왔습니다.

가끔은 생각이 너무 빠른 탓에 주변 사람들은 유니의 행동을 엉뚱하고 별나다고 생각할지도 모르지만
유니는 언제나 스스로의 판단과 행동에 확신을 가지고 있습니다.

[b]래빗밤[/b] Active Skill
사용 시 전방으로 빠르게 질주합니다.

[b]리로드[/b] Passive Skill
용병 스킬 사용 시 활성화 되어 있는 무기의 기본 탄창이 재장전됩니다.

일반 배틀 슈트
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/6a7facb130b186ea0c30f577f95b0726453d41bc.png[/img]

희귀 배틀 슈트
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/dc6a78957cb45921d857831b2a1841ea72adffab.png[/img]

영웅 배틀 슈트
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/80ee72e294dc61083670ad064bf4daa33cbcd12a.png[/img]


[h3][b]3. 어스(M-224) / 모나틴 족[/b][/h3]
″삐빅-빅쀼빅-빅-빅″

완벽하게 창조된 인공지능을 탑재한 기계,
모나틴족의 어스(M-224)는 이제 막 탄생한지 10년이 되지 않은 용병입니다.

기계로 이루어진 강인한 몸체를 바탕으로 버려진 땅에서의 전투 방식을 효율적으로 학습한 어스(M-224)는
뛰어난 전투력을 보유한 무시무시한 용병이 아닐 수 없지만
그의 정신은 순수하며 세상에 대한 호기심으로 가득 차 있습니다.

어스(M-224)의 최우선 행동 원리는 바로 호기심이며
그가 버려진 땅으로 향하는 가장 큰 목적 역시
대몰락 이전의 세계에 대한 호기심을 충족하기 위해서입니다.

[b]택티컬 카운터[/b] Active Skill
스킬 사용 시 실드를 생성하고 방어력이 90% 상승합니다.
최대 5초 동안 유지 할 수 있으며 사용 시 강력한 레이저를 발사합니다.

[b]오버히트[/b] Passive Skill
용병 스킬 사용을 하면 5초간 ″오버히트″ 상태가 됩니다.
″오버히트″ 상태에서 적 타격 시 타격된 적은 화상 지속데미지를 받습니다.

notes.title: 테스터 확정 메일 오발송 관련 안내
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41733370/bdbe3eb0e6eb3e63f1fb83651aed36a38caa197b.png[/img]

안녕하세요.
리턴 얼라이브입니다.

기존에 신청해 주신 테스터 분들께 2월 23일에 발송되어야 하는 테스터 확정 메일이 오발송 되는 문제가 있었습니다.
오발송 된 메일에는 지금 플레이가 가능하다고 안내되어 있지만 이는 잘 못 안내된 내용이며 해당 메일을 받으신 분들은 기존 테스트 시작일인 2월 23일 18시 이후 스팀에 접속하시면 라이브러리에 리턴 얼라이브가 등록되어 있을 예정입니다.

일부 신청자분들께 혼선을 드려 죄송합니다.
이후에도 리턴 얼라이브에 많은 관심 부탁드립니다.

notes.title: Return Alive CBT scheduled on Feb will only be available in Korea.
notes.content:
Hello Players,
Thank you for your interest in Return Alive.

Return Alive is currently being developed with global service in mind. 
However, due to the difficulties of localizing in multiple languages, the CBT that will be held on February will only be available for players in Korea.
Please note that the CBT service will not be available for players outside of Korea even though the Request Access button will be visible for players of all regions, as Steam does not have the function to limit requests to specific regions.

We will announce through Steam once we are prepared for CBT for all regions, so please add us to your Wishlist to receive all future news and notifications as soon as they are available.

We hope to see you soon!
Thank you.
